PROVENANCE: Independently fetched current PR7 diff and Core/exchange_truth/test code from GitHub, reviewed issue #3 comments 6083130794 and 6083189802, prior G3/Architect invariants and seq65 scope ruling. PR7 is OPEN and unmerged. RUN1_FINDINGS.md is cited by PR and Claude but IS NOT TRACKED on main or PR7 head, and GitHub code search yielded no accessible copy; its specific measured run evidence is UNVERIFIED. Claude's reported test counts remain self-reports, not Controller/Hermes proof.

RULING:
1. ACCEPT IN PRINCIPLE narrow fast price/metadata acquisition for the default DEX and exact HIP-3 DEXes actually traded, plus optional preloading. The default parallel post_many implementation may be evaluated as a performance tool, not a safety waiver. A leader event may select a market for observation, not mint trade authority. No blanket right to drop unseen markets from account truth.
2. REJECT CURRENT G3 SEMANTIC SUBSTITUTION. G3 requires authoritative follower MASTER net exposure, risk/caps, attribution and independent settlement across ALL RELEVANT perp DEX scopes, default and HIP-3, with unknown/unavailable required scopes failing CLOSED. PR7 substitutes scoped master_exposure() for account-wide caps and ENG-016, backed by periodic out-of-scope survey every 300s and a success age up to 900s; this does not establish CURRENT all-relevant-scope truth at the order-authority decision. A new external/manual out-of-scope position can arise after the sweep. If that full-scope current truth cannot be obtained within safe latency, remain blocked and escalate, rather than quietly relaxing G3.
3. INDEPENDENT CODE DEFECTS / CONDITIONS:
   a. run_scope_sweep() records _scope_sweep_last on failed reads but leaves the old _scope_sweep_ok intact. _scope_sweep_block() can continue permitting ENTRY until the previous success turns 900s old. A failed/partial newer required sweep must immediately invalidate eligibility.
   b. learn_follower_dex() mutates dynamic monitored DEXes, but follower_exposure() returns the old <=2s cached _exposure without checking scope identity. Re-learning new held/traded DEX must invalidate dependent exposure/price/meta snapshots and produce a verified fresh risk decision before entry.
   c. Prove that the entire required DEX universe has been enumerated without gaps, including exact DEX identity and newly listed/unreadable markets, without merging ambiguous duplicate ticker keys. Every required scope read missing -> fail closed. Preserving old position ownership is mandatory; sweep-discovered inventory is OBSERVATION ONLY and not engine-owned target or authorised send.
   d. Confirm an entry cannot reach ANY send path (including retries/recovery) with a stale, failed or pending full-scope truth check. Exits of independently proven engine-owned inventory remain safely available; unrelated/manual inventory never adopted, flattened or closed.
4. UI truth-card changes U1–U5 are separately reviewable on exact runtime data and truth-tier labels, but cannot justify merging the bundled G3-incompatible PR. Do not silently suppress existing working UI controls; independently certify affected controls.
5. Existing OD01 <=5s follower-market MID for execution pricing and F3 <=1s exact-DEX exchange markPx for FIXED slice sizing remain distinct. PR7 improves the mid path only, does not certify Core G2/G3/G4 or resolve reported G2 FLATTEN SELL.
6. Required acceptance before any PR7 merge: Claude's full RUN1_FINDINGS.md raw physical evidence must be pushed or linkable; executed deterministic negative checks of a new foreign position immediately after a successful sweep, newer-sweep failure after success, partial/unavailable enumeration, scope expansion during <=2s cache TTL, held foreign inventory and unknown market, and first testnet full-sweep/quote latency; all assessed by Controller against exact head+tests, Graphify refreshed and read on the SAME head. Existing Graphify built from 81c394bd is stale for current Core.
7. If proposed amended semantics still rely on a 900s cached survey as authoritative CURRENT all-DEX truth, ARCHITECT_REVIEW_REQUIRED again with explicit trade-off and operator decision. No unilateral waiver.

CONTROL/OWNERSHIP: Claude retains exclusive active runtime ownership until explicit FINAL handoff. Controller may coordinate review/amendment with Claude; this ruling is NOT a Hermes implementation order and does not interrupt active Claude runtime. Hermes WAIT_AUTHORISED/report-before-act. Local receiver/session registry proof remains pending. Do not merge, start duplicate testnet run, send/cancel/close/adopt exposure, alter product permissions or self-set standdown.
